{"idea":"Use the difference equation to write m = n + 2. Since m is positive, the product equation bounds n by 288; checking those finitely many natural values leaves n = 16 and hence m = 18.","proof":"have hnpos : 0 < n := by
  by_contra hn
  have hn0 : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
  subst n
  norm_num at h₃
have hmpos : 0 < m := by
  by_contra hm
  have hm0 : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hm
  subst m
  norm_num at h₃
have hmn : m = n + 2 := by omega
have hnle : n ≤ 288 := by
  calc
    n = 1 * n := by omega
    _ ≤ m * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right n (by omega)
    _ = 288 := h₃.symm
interval_cases n <;> norm_num at h₃ <;> omega","insight_statement":"","insight_proof":""}
